---
title: "ARBITER manuscript results"
---

```{r}
source('run.R')
source('R/report.R')
main_tables <- list(benchmark_table(inputs),main_table2(),main_table3(),main_table4())
legends <- figure_legend_sections()
```

The benchmark compares ARBITER with an Unassisted model on 102 trials from 16 meta-analyses. Blinded adjudication of disputed domain judgements is the primary quantitative evidence. Sonnet 5.5 is the main analysis; Haiku 5.5 analyses appear in the [supplement](supplement.html). Each arm assessed each trial once.

```{r}
for(i in 1:6) {
  cat('\n## ',names(legends)[i],'\n\n',sep='')
  cat('![',names(legends)[i],'](output/manuscript/Figure',i,'.png)\n\n',sep='')
  if(i<3 && file.exists('output/manuscript/legends-fig1-2.md')) {
    supplied <- readLines('output/manuscript/legends-fig1-2.md',warn=FALSE)
    starts <- grep(paste0('^## Figure ',i,'[.]'),supplied)
    if(length(starts)) {
      end <- c(grep('^## Figure ',supplied),length(supplied)+1L)
      stop <- min(end[end>starts[1]])-1L
      cat(paste(supplied[seq.int(starts[1]+1L,stop)],collapse='\n'),'\n')
    } else cat(legends[[i]],'\n')
  } else cat(legends[[i]],'\n')
}
```

```{r}
for(i in 1:4) {
  cat('\n## Table ',i,'. ',c('Benchmark set','Agreement (95% CI)','RoB 2 rule consistency and audit','Reliability of the reference standard (95% CI)')[i],'\n\n',sep='')
  cat(flextable::flextable_to_rmd(main_table_flextable(main_tables[[i]],i)),sep='\n')
}
```

## Key results

```{r}
p <- manuscript_data('primary-endpoint') |> filter(analysis=='Consensus',metric=='ARBITER')
```

Among the 62 consensus cells where the Sonnet arms differed, ARBITER won 54, Unassisted won 7, and neither won 1. The ARBITER win share was `r fmt_number(100*p$estimate,1)`% (95% CI `r fmt_number(100*p$lower,1)`–`r fmt_number(100*p$upper,1)`%). Only this endpoint is confirmatory. Intervals use 10,000 trial-cluster resamples stratified by meta-analysis (seed 20261018). No p-values or multiplicity corrections are used.

```{r}
process <- manuscript_data('table5')
for(j in 1:2) cat(paste0(if(j==1) 'Median time (minutes per trial)' else 'Median API list-price equivalent (USD per trial)',': ARBITER ',fmt_process_text(process[['ARBITER-Sonnet']][j]),'; Unassisted ',fmt_process_text(process[['Baseline-Sonnet']][j]),'. Paired mean difference (95% CI): ',fmt_process_text(process[['Paired mean difference (95% CI)']][j]),'.\n\n'))
```

## How to reproduce

Use ARBITER 1.0.0, public commit `2f549ae`. The [GitHub repository](https://github.com/alisalman-et-al/arbiter-JAMIA) contains the analysis code, source identifiers, derived run metrics and adjudication data. Trial PDFs are not redistributed. The [supplement HTML](supplement.html) mirrors [Supplement.docx](output/manuscript/Supplement.docx).

From the repository root:

```sh
cd analysis
Rscript -e "renv::restore()"
Rscript -e "testthat::test_dir('tests/testthat')"
quarto render
```

The optional extraction command `uv run python extract-avatar-trace.py` refreshes the illustrative trace when the local run bundle and rationale log are available; rendering uses committed derived files. Code is in `analysis/R/`, tests in `analysis/tests/testthat/`, curated metadata in `analysis/data-curated/`, derived data in `analysis/data-derived/`, numerical exports in `analysis/output/tables/`, and publication files in `analysis/output/manuscript/`.
